definitions: The form of a medium embeds itself in the message, creating a symbiotic relationship by which the medium influences how the message is perceived.
The way information is delivered is more important than the information itself.
examples: In the age of social media, the medium is the message, as the platform shapes the content.
McLuhan's famous phrase, 'the medium is the message,' highlights how technology impacts society.
When considering online news, the medium is the message; the website's design affects credibility.
